prompt: A woman in her late thirties sits at a kitchen counter mid-morning, talking to a phone propped against a coffee mug. Window light falls from her left, so the right side of her face sits in soft shadow and a contact shadow pools under the mug. Real skin: visible pores across the nose and cheeks, a little shine on the forehead, one small blemish near the jaw, fine lines at the eyes. She wears a plain olive cotton t-shirt, slightly creased. The background is a lived-in kitchen, softly out of focus: a dish rack with one bowl, a knife block, a cabinet door not quite shut. Shot on a phone front camera at chest-up framing, slightly off-centre, the horizon a touch tilted. Neutral colour, no grade. No text anywhere in the frame.
